posts.name: Dalyodh Singh
posts.cooked:
use sed instead awk for extracting 1~3 starting from 1 line with step size 3 and then use grep -Eo ‘[0-9]+’ to extract digits from INVESTMENT line

Second way use grep to extract numbers preceded by $ symbol using -o then removing $ from it and then add it into sum variable

It is very very simple if you understand the question first

Regards,
Dalyodh Singh

posts.name: Dalyodh Singh
posts.cooked:
please avoid using awk and sed for now , because when you print something using sed or awk , storing it in variable $file is not possible so use grep to filter out numeric value from each line and then store into some variable and add into sum while iterating through each line

Make your code simple and use grep only for now.
Please solve it by yourself , you will learn a lot in bash and grep.
Regards,
Dalyodh Singh
